role: An open-addressing-free chained hash map from int keys to objects, used by the entity tracker, the client world, pathfinding and key bindings to look entities and objects up by id.

members.name: slots/slotCount/count/field_76055_q
members.note: each consumer replaces the map with a fixed-capacity array; the entity tracker's id-to-entry map is tracker.h's entries[512]

members.name: lookup
members.note: the tracker's by-id lookup; linear over the array instead of hashed

members.name: Entry.getHash/getValue/equals/hashCode/toString
members.note: the entry's own accessors: IntHashMap reads the fields directly; equals, hashCode and toString have no caller in oracle/src (entries are never compared, hashed or printed)

notes: Only the entity-tracker use was traced. The GPU contract prefers flat fixed-capacity arrays over pointer-bucket maps (SPEC 'Java, then C, then the GPU'), so the map itself is intentionally not ported. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: No generic int-keyed hash map exists natively; every consumer keeps its own fixed-capacity array, so other IntHashMap users (KeyBinding, PathFinder, NetHandlerPlayServer, WorldServer) were not individually traced.
